entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange associated with Vilnius, Lithuania. Public exchange data stopped updating in 2024 and multiple independent market directories now treat the trading venue as inactive, while a legacy ExMarkets support center remains reachable.
entity.notes: The EU Digital Finance Platform records ExMarkets in Vilnius, Lithuania and gives launch year 2017, while other historical sources commonly cite 2018 and describe a British Virgin Islands operating company. HEI therefore leaves the exact launch date null and uses Lithuania as country_or_origin based on the EU institutional location record, not as a claim about every later corporate registration. Cryptowisser reported the website inaccessible on 2024-09-18 and marked the exchange inactive/dead; CoinPaprika reports its last exchange data input as 2024-05-22. No first-party shutdown notice or exact terminal date was found, so HEI records inactive rather than dead and leaves death_reason/death_date null. The still-reachable Kayako support center is treated as legacy identity/support evidence, not proof that trading remains active.

evidence.title: ExMarkets — EU Digital Finance Platform
evidence.publisher: European Commission — EU Digital Finance Platform
evidence.notes: Institutional directory identifies ExMarkets, gives launch year 2017, location Vilnius, Lithuania, and links to exmarkets.com. Because independent sources disagree on launch year, HEI does not convert the year-only value into an exact launch_date.

evidence.title: ExMarkets exchange review and inactive notice
evidence.notes: Cryptowisser states that it could not access ExMarkets on September 18, 2024 and consequently marked the exchange inactive/dead. HEI uses this as evidence of inactivity only, not as proof of an exact shutdown date or cause.

evidence.title: ExMarkets Exchange Statistics
evidence.notes: CoinPaprika labels ExMarkets a centralized exchange and reports the last exchange data input as May 22, 2024 with no current markets or volume.

evidence.title: ExMarkets Support Center
evidence.notes: Legacy first-party-branded support center remains reachable and identifies the ExMarkets service. Its availability is not treated as evidence that the exchange trading platform is currently active.
